title: 第19章 销赃第20章 炼器
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 魂牵梦绕是一卷修练神魂的功法，其反噬自然也与神魂息息相关，书中提到每个人修练时产生的魂梦并不一样，受到的反噬也会不一样，有的人可能只是神魂有些许损伤，有的人却不止会神魂大伤，体内灵力也会暴动，走火入魔。
巫未央大惊，按照书籍的描述查看了陈沫的状态，他体内灵力紊乱，正是走火入魔的前兆。
掌门可真倒霉，巫未央不禁想道。
神魂受损，巫未央没有别的办法，再一次去到了珍宝阁。
侍女听完她的需求，推荐道，“神魂受损可以购买六阶养魂丹。”
巫未央一听六阶，就觉得价格不菲，捂着储物袋犹豫问道，“养魂丹多少钱？”
侍女：“下品养魂丹一颗只需十块上品灵石。”
很好，完美踩着她钱包的极限。
至今，二十块上品灵石到手花出去六块买生机丹，八十块下品灵石买回春丹和回血丹，现在又花出去十块上品灵石买养魂丹，只剩下三块多。
巫未央只希望这养魂丹有效。
事实证明，贵的东西还是有点效果的，陈沫服下养魂丹后，气色一天比一天好，药效吸收完估计就能醒过来了。
这期间巫未央也没有眼睁睁看着，而是一点一点地帮陈沫梳理体内灵力，防止他醒来就变成魔头。
陈沫醒来的时候恰好是午后，温暖的阳光下清风吹拂，窗前的纱帘飞舞，恍若梦境。
三年前，他应友人之约前去秘境，意外得到魂牵梦绕，这本功法乃高阶功法，两人欣喜若狂，可是魂牵梦绕需要魂晶辅助修练，而随魂牵梦绕一起被发现的魂晶只有一枚。
功法和魂晶是陈沫得到的，理应属于他，友人一开始也并未展露出争抢的心思，还愿意为他护法，却没有想到，居然是想趁他修炼时下手。
逼得他中途打断修炼，遭受反噬，如果不是活了这么久有些逃命手段，他甚至都回不到朝天宗。
奈何反噬太过严重，他连自救都来不及。
所以醒来时，他十分惊讶。
陈沫睁开混满血丝的双眼，坐起身扫视一圈，一眼看到了趴在长案前沉睡的巫未央。
她穿着灰白的宽大道袍，身骨依旧清瘦得不行，却有着满头墨发，让人不禁联想，她吃下的营养是不是都被头发吸了去。
陈沫眼中闪过一抹复杂，三年前的一时心软，竟在三年后的今日救了他，这就是天意吗。
他来到长案前，看到桌上散乱的草稿，拿起来看了看，顿时目露震惊。
巫未央为了救陈沫，仔细研读了魂牵梦绕与人体经脉，许多地方写了注解，而陈沫震惊的是，一个十岁的孩子竟然聪慧到如此程度，那些注解，连他看了都禁不住赞同。
她明显寡见少闻，很多想法青涩懵懂，但有的却刁钻地解决了问题。
如若不是她这番冒险，他还真的醒不过来。
他正沉浸在巫未央草稿里的时候，巫未央悠悠转醒。
她眨了眨眼，看到面前沉思的老者，惊喜道，“掌门您醒了！”
陈沫：“多谢你了，如果没有你，老夫只怕早已归西。”
说罢，他储物戒指里拿出一个圆滚滚的小袋子。
“救命之恩无以为报，如今你修为尚低，许多东西用不了，想这灵石大概就是你最实用的东西了。”
content_en:
Dreaming Around the Soul is a book of techniques for cultivating the soul, and its backlash is naturally closely related to the soul. The book mentions that everyone has different soul dreams during practice, and the backlash they receive will also be different. Some people may only have a slight damage to the soul, but some people will not only have the soul seriously injured, but the spiritual power in the body will also riot and become possessed.
Wu Weiyang was shocked and checked Chen Mo's condition according to the description in the book. The spiritual disorder in his body was a precursor to becoming possessed.
…
The leader is really unlucky, Wu Weiyang couldn't help but think.
With his soul damaged, Wu Weiyang had no other option and went to the Treasure Pavilion again.
After hearing her needs, the maid recommended, "If your soul is damaged, you can buy a sixth-level soul nourishing pill."
When Wu Weiyang heard about the sixth level, he felt that it was expensive. He held his storage bag and asked hesitantly, "How much does the soul nourishing pill cost?"
Maid: "A low-grade soul nourishing pill only costs ten high-grade spiritual stones."
Very good, perfectly at the limit of her wallet.
So far, I have spent 20 yuan of high-grade spiritual stones on six yuan of vitality pills, 80 yuan of low-grade spiritual stones on rejuvenation pills and blood rejuvenation pills, and now I have spent 10 yuan of high-grade spiritual stones on soul-nourishing pills, leaving only more than three yuan.
Wu Weiyang only hoped that this soul nourishing pill would be effective.
Facts have proved that expensive things are still somewhat effective. After Chen Mo took the soul-nourishing pill, his complexion became better day by day. He will probably wake up after the effect of the medicine is absorbed.
During this period, Wu Weiyang did not just watch, but helped Chen Mo sort out the spiritual power in his body bit by bit to prevent him from turning into a demon when he woke up.
It was just afternoon when Chen Mo woke up. The breeze was blowing under the warm sunshine, and the gauze curtains in front of the window were flying, as if in a dream.
Three years ago, at the invitation of a friend, he went to the secret realm and unexpectedly got the Soul Lian Meng Ling. This skill was a high-level skill. The two of them were overjoyed. However, Hun Lian Meng Ling needed soul crystals to assist in training, and only one soul crystal was found along with Hun Lian Meng Lian.
The technique and soul crystal were obtained by Chen Mo, and they should belong to him. His friends did not show any intention of fighting for them at first, and were willing to protect him, but they did not expect that they actually wanted to take advantage of him while he was practicing.
He was forced to interrupt his training midway and suffered backlash. If he hadn't had some means of escape after living for so long, he wouldn't even be able to return to Chaotian Sect.
However, the backlash was so severe that he couldn't even save himself in time.
So when he woke up, he was very surprised.
Chen Mo opened his bloodshot eyes, sat up and looked around, and saw Wu Weiyang sleeping in front of the long case.
She was wearing a gray wide robe, her body was still extremely thin, but she had a head full of black hair, which made people wonder if all the nutrients she had eaten were absorbed by her hair.
A complicated look flashed in Chen Mo's eyes. He was soft-hearted three years ago, but he was saved today three years later. Is this God's will?
When he came to the long desk, he saw the scattered drafts on the table. He picked them up and looked at them, and he was suddenly shocked.
In order to save Chen Mo, Wu Weiyang carefully studied the meridians of the soul and the human body, and wrote annotations in many places. Chen Mo was shocked that a ten-year-old child could be so smart. Even he couldn't help but agree with those annotations.
She is obviously ignorant and ignorant, and many of her ideas are naive and ignorant, but some of them solve problems in a cunning way.
If it weren't for her adventure, he really wouldn't be able to wake up.
When he was immersed in Wu Weiyang's draft, Wu Weiyang suddenly woke up.
She blinked and saw the meditating old man in front of her, and said in surprise, "Master, you're awake!"
Chen Mo: "Thank you very much. Without you, I would have returned to the West long ago."
After that, he took out a small round bag from his storage ring.
"I can't repay my life-saving grace. Now that your cultivation level is still low, you can't use many things. I think this spirit stone is probably the most practical thing for you."
